## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused solution.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated relevant tests
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Browser or visual checks when UI behavior changed
- [ ] `npm run package:check` when package output changed
- [ ] `git diff --check`

## Public Surface

- [ ] Updated README, API docs, examples, and changelog where needed
- [ ] Considered Persian, RTL, keyboard, and screen-reader behavior
- [ ] Disclosed material AI assistance, or none was used
